entities.summary: Ewell is a town in the Epsom and Ewell district, in Surrey, England, 12 miles south of central London and two miles northeast of Epsom. At the 2011 Census, it had a population of 34,872. The majority (73%) was in the ABC1 social class, except the Ruxley Ward that is C2DE.
